items.detail: PatentTerminalParseError: Largan Family 81328003 item 1; paragraphs 44-53 and FIGS. 1-6 publish camera module 1 with carrier, actuator, four-ball-group and V/U-groove mechanics. The exact source publishes no ordered optical radius, spacing, material, refractive-index/dispersion, conic, asphere, aperture-stop or system focal/F-number/image-height prescription. Actuator geometry, qualitative camera roles and the vehicle deployment field range remain architecture metadata and do not create a prescription. Claims 1-17, including independent camera-module claims 1/10 and dependent electronic/vehicle claims 8/9, add no separate ordered prescription. No value is derived, measured from drawings, transcribed from raster, or borrowed from prior publication US-20230100691-A1, provisional application 63/248966, another family or a shared layout
